title: runs.jsonl
description: One line per skill execution. This is what makes the call budget measurable — only if the fields are exactly these.

ts.patternHint: a full ISO timestamp in UTC, e.g. 2026-09-08T14:02:11Z, not a date

calls.description: Sealmetrics tool calls this run actually made. Counted, not estimated.

budget.description: The ceiling the skill documents for itself.

notes.description: One line about THIS run. Never a repeat of an older note, and never anything about bots.
